question: nq question: who is the pastor of new birth missionary baptist church now

evidence_sources.title: New Birth Missionary Baptist Church - Wikipedia

spans.text: In 2017, Stephen A. Davis, pastor of New Birth Birmingham in Birmingham, Alabama became senior pastor while remaining pastor of the Birmingham. However in June, 2018 Bishop Davis resigned.
In December 2018, Jamal Bryant became senior pastor.
Celebrity pastor Jamal Bryant is the senior pastor since 2018.
